services.desc: Panama City Parasail is the beach’s original parasail company, flying high since 1987. Fly up to 1,200 feet of line for the highest, longest, and most scenic parasail ride in PCB. Take in breathtaking views of Panama City Beach, St. Andrews Bay, and the Gulf of Mexico as you soar above the emerald waters. Our experience is designed to be fast, smooth, and stress-free. You’ll be flying within minutes of leaving the marina-no long boat rides, no waiting, and no rough Gulf conditions.
